what: An FDSN StationXML document with a full instrument response (poles and zeros, two coefficient stages including a 39-term FIR), used by the acceptance suite to prove this program's response evaluation against evalresp.
channel: IU.ANMO.10.BHZ (Albuquerque, New Mexico; Guralp CMG3-T borehole; 40 Hz; sensitivity 3.31283E10 counts per m/s at 0.02 Hz)
source: IRIS-DMC fdsnws-station, level=response (the ModuleURI inside the file names the query); the document as carried in obspy 1.5.1's test data (obspy/core/tests/data/IRIS_single_channel_with_response.xml). FDSN station metadata served by IRIS/EarthScope is openly redistributable.

reference_values.how: obspy 1.5.1 Response.get_evalresp_response_for_frequencies (evalresp) on the maintainer's machine, 2026-10-03; [frequency Hz, |H| counts per unit, phase degrees]

deconvolution_check: on the maintainer's machine, this program's remove_response against obspy's on a real 3-hour IU.ULN.00.LH1 record with this response forced on it: relative rms difference 0.9 % (VEL), 1.1 % (DISP), 1.1 % (ACC) with the pre-filter 0.005-0.01-0.4-0.45 Hz; the remainder is the two programs' taper and detrend conventions
